message: Chapter received: Concepts of Physics — Ch. 3, "Rest and Motion: Kinematics" — 42 pages, 11 worked examples.
Curriculum agent (Gemini 4 Argon): reading chapter. Splitting into teachable units…
Curriculum agent (Gemini 4 Argon): found 5 concepts, 8 misconceptions. Top misconception: "average speed tells you the speed at every moment".
Writers' room (Gemini 4 Argon): 2 drafts written; judge kept draft B (13/15).
Story agent (Gemini 4 Argon): world is "The Ravine at Pathargarh". A dust-and-ochre ravine western, a dacoit with an alibi, and a timetable signed by the man reading it to you.
Binding concepts to verbs: average speed → deduction board, braking distance → the wagon brake, projectile motion → aim and launch.
Rejected Act II (guessable, 64%): the siding swallowed almost every brake you could hold, so any late grab worked. Repairing…
Act II narrowed: the siding is 30 m of a 170 m grade, so only a brake judged against her speed stops her inside it.
Re-scored: Act II guessable 20%. Solution wins, default loses, all three acts concept-necessary.
Art director (Nano Banana): style plate locked — isometric ravine country, bleached khaki and ochre stone, four-o-clock light.
Art director (Nano Banana): cast painted against the plate — Pawar and Girdhari, portrait and sprite each, so they look related.
Art director (Nano Banana): one sprite per interactable, placed on its own collider — art cannot drift from the physics.
Cast sheet: Subedar Hari Pawar (3 moods), Station Master Girdhari Lal (3 moods). Girdhari personifies the misconception, so he stays likeable.
Tracing isometric colliders from scene art: 8 blocked volumes, 2 interactables, 1 exit per scene.
Scene QA (Gemini Flash): walkability passed — spawn reaches the reckoning board, the wagon brake and the launcher.
World ready. 3 acts, 3 isometric scenes, 2 characters. Step into the station cabin.
